decisions.reason: As a 2023 laser-marking line with several models that remained on the website in 2024 and fits the firm's established offer, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse invested development and launch efforts.

This printer is close to the core coding business, still had its own product page in 2024, and a large R&D-oriented German machinery firm would be inclined to persist with such an introduced platform.
Because it is a close extension of the firm's existing inkjet offering and stayed prominently presented in 2024, management would likely justify continued commitment rather than withdraw quickly.

As a 2024 flagship line shown on the home page and tied directly to the firm's announced Industry 4.0 direction, it carries the strongest public and strategic commitment and is very unlikely to be dropped so soon.
The newly launched laser cabin broadens the firm's laser portfolio, was given its own page, and would likely be retained while management gives the recent launch more time to pay off.

Although more specialized, it won a trade-fair award and supports the established industrial marking business, so management would likely see enough validation to continue rather than exit within a year.
